findings.title: The denial matrix does not prove byte-exact no-mutation for every required case
findings.reproduction: At exact candidate 7d004e69620f5eddbbbacd038f341b5a4e423df6, inspect tests/foundation/test_recoveryctl.py methods test_b01_scope_addendum_is_exact_commit_bound_and_fail_closed, test_b01_scope_addendum_rejects_stale_forked_and_wrong_candidates_without_mutation, and test_b01_scope_addendum_rejects_semantic_authority_substitutions_without_mutation. The stale, copied-fork, self-reviewed, wrong-path, extra-scope, and explicitly-unapproved cases snapshot and compare both planning/backlog.yaml and planning/governance-control-recovery/GCR-0001.B00.state.json. The wrong/base candidate case snapshots and compares only planning/backlog.yaml, and the retained altered-approval and missing/partial-authority cases compare neither authoritative file. Run `rg -n "approval_payload|wrong_candidate_snapshot|stale_snapshot|fork_snapshot|snapshot =" tests/foundation/test_recoveryctl.py` to reproduce the assertion asymmetry. All 27 tests still pass because those omitted assertions are absent. This conflicts with GRR-0002.B01-R01-F01's required remediation that each denial prove fail-closed behavior without backlog/state mutation, the approved addendum's no-mutation criterion, and remediation evidence statements that every new denial has byte-exact backlog/control-state assertions.

Retain the real-Git authority construction and approval-commit ancestry guard. Because the next submission is R03 with open findings, include a concrete root-cause analysis explaining why the R02 assertion matrix was incomplete, bind fresh canonical GRR-0002.B01.remediation-02.evidence.json to the strict descendant, rerun the full affected suite and authority/planning checks, and resubmit only through `recoveryctl supplement-resubmit`. The R03 review must explicitly close both GRR-0002.B01-R01-F01 and GRR-0002.B01-R02-F01 before approval.
